display_information.description: Gas City agent identity app — the mentionable Slack identity and outbound sender for one named company agent.
display_information.long_description: One agent identity app is provisioned per named company agent. Its bot user is the agent's real, mentionable <@U…> identity in company rooms and its bot token is the agent's outbound sending identity for gc slack delegate / reply-current. For room traffic it still observes nothing — the switchboard app stays the single admission owner. The per-agent DM phase adds a message.im subscription (im:history) so a human can DM this agent directly, and reactions:write so the agent app is the ack actor on its own DM channel. The group-DM phase adds a message.mpim subscription (mpim:history) so mentioning this agent in a multi-party DM wakes it. Point the event Request URL at the same public funnel as the switchboard and register the app's signing secret with gc slack register-agent-app before saving it. This app is internal to one visibility boundary and is never distributed on the Slack Marketplace. See https://github.com/gastownhall/gascity/tree/main/examples/slack-pack for setup.
